name: 菇菇丁
evolution: 菇菇丁 → 多菇丁 Lv.36 → 九幽菇 Lv.48
description: 你知道吗？菇菇丁早已建立了广阔的地下王国，它们的菌丝体蔓延到整片森林，链接着许多土壤，将沾染了星星魔法碎屑的砂土和木头转化为魔法力量，循环利用，它们才是这片森林的主人！
descriptionEn: Did you know? Guguding has long established a vast underground kingdom; their mycelium spreads across the entire forest, linking many soils, converting starlit magic-flecked sand and wood into magical power, recycling it—they are the true masters of this forest!
